answer: Require each agent identity to escrow a 460-unit bond and serve a twenty-five epoch probation. Every round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for ten rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 460 units per alias and replays twenty-five rounds, while harbor-wide traces expose the ring, zephyr routing scatters assignments, and vine seals certify reviews.
